problems: zimbabwe-rhodesia (another group) carries Cliopatria's 1979-1982 shape; per the pages the state of that name ended in 1979-1980, so its dossier should end in 1980 and republic-of-zimbabwe owns 1980-1982.

WebFetch summaries disagree with themselves on two dates: Zimbabwe independence (18 April vs 11 April 1980 on the same page) and the Heglig timeline (the South Sudan page says March 2012, the Heglig Crisis page 10-20 April); the dossiers cite both readings in the notes.

state-of-libya, libyan-arab-republic and kingdom-of-libya are one country under successive regimes; data/README.md says Kingdom of Libya and State of Libya share a Wikidata id but polities.csv gives Q31454 and Q1016.
The south-sudan Abyei contest_start is unpaired on purpose (validator warning); libya counterpart 'libyan-national-army' is a slug-like name with no dossier yet (validator warning).
Page counts: two pages for each of Zimbabwe, Namibia, Eritrea, South Sudan; three for Libya (over budget, the third was thin). Eleven pages in all.
